description:
Analysis extent for Flood, Kenya, 8 May 2018 (FL20180508KEN): 1 features merged from 1 source layer. Layers whose names mark the area UNOSAT analysed, or parts of it with no usable imagery (analysis extent, area of interest, cloud obstruction, no-data, image footprint). The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Potentially affected population by flooding in eastern Kenya](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/potentially-affected-population-by-flooding-in-eastern-kenya-2804)
- [Satellite detected water along Tana River, Bura ub county, Tana River county, Kenya](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-along-tana-river-bura-ub-county-tana-river-county-kenya-2798)
- [Satellite detected water along Tana River, Galole & Garsen sub counties, TanaRiver county, Kenya](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-along-tana-river-galole-garsen-sub-counties-tanariver-county-kenya-2799)
- [Satellite detected water over Dadaab Sub County, Garissa County](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-over-dadaab-sub-county-garissa-county-2802)
- [Satellite detected water over Garsen Sub County, Tana River County, Kenya](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-over-garsen-sub-county-tana-river-county-kenya-2794)
- [Satellite detected water over Wajir county, Kenya](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-over-wajir-county-kenya-2801)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.

title: Analysis extent: Flood, Kenya, 8 May 2018 (FL20180508KEN)
